hero.badge: Next-Gen QR & POS Solution for Hospitality
hero.title: Hospitality without friction.
hero.subtitle: Empower your restaurant, cafe, or bar with instant QR ordering, split-bill payments, and real-time kitchen display.

landing.heroDesc: Qore is a platform for cafés and restaurants. Guests at the same table see a shared menu in real time and split the bill themselves, while the AI engine lifts average order value and takes routine work off your team.

comparison.title: Why not just a QR code to a PDF
comparison.typical1: Static PDF that's hard to update from a phone
comparison.typical2: Slow to load on weak in-house Wi-Fi
comparison.typical3: Every guest has their own separate cart
comparison.typical4: The server splits the bill by hand
comparison.qore1: Server-rendered, ready in under a second
comparison.qore2: One shared table cart, updated in real time
comparison.qore3: Guests split the bill themselves — evenly or by item
comparison.qore4: Menu is edited in the dashboard and updates instantly

howItWorks.title: How it works at one table
howItWorks.step1Desc: The menu opens instantly in the browser — no app, no sign-up.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Everyone at the table sees one cart and what others add, in real time.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Evenly or by chosen items — guests pay themselves, no server needed.

features.title: Everything a venue needs — free
features.description: Live cart, split billing, order-ahead, and the 86 list are all on the Free plan. We don't hold these back to upsell you — only AI is paid.
features.liveCartDesc: Several guests at one table see the same menu and one shared cart, updated live.
features.splitBillDesc: Evenly or by chosen items — guests settle up themselves, no server needed.
features.orderAheadDesc: Guests order on the way and skip the line the moment they arrive.
features.stopListDesc: 86 a dish from the kitchen and it disappears from every active table session instantly.
features.happyHourDesc: A discount with a live countdown; prices recalculate automatically when it ends.
features.npsDesc: Guests rate their visit right after paying — a low score pings you on Telegram instantly.

aiShowcase.titlePart2: that makes money, not just a demo
aiShowcase.subtitle: The core product is free and built to spread on its own. We deliberately kept expensive LLM calls behind the paid tiers — that's a growth engine, not a hook.

splitBill.title: The check, split in seconds
splitBill.description: Guests pay for what they actually ordered. No awkward math with the server, no mistakes — every item is tagged with the guest who added it.
splitBill.benefit1: Every item remembers who ordered it
splitBill.benefit2: Pay just your share or split evenly
splitBill.benefit3: Lock items before paying — no race conditions
